title: Distance Band Tariff for Trade-In Tows
content:
Longer **Trade-In Agreements** tows are charged at lower per-mile tow rates, banded by the one-way tow distance recorded on the delivery appointment of the purchase the trade is applied to.

| One-way tow distance | Per-mile tow rate |
|---|---|
| Longer than 50 miles | $1.50 |
| Longer than 30 miles but not longer than 50 miles | $1.75 |
| 30 miles or shorter | The standard per-mile tow rate |

## Band boundaries

| One-way distance | Rate |
|---|---|
| 30 miles | The standard per-mile tow rate |
| 31 miles | $1.75 |
| 50 miles | $1.75 |
| 51 miles | $1.50 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A one-way distance of 64 miles with 25 included miles: 39 miles beyond the included miles at $1.50, which is $58.50.
